about: Where each engine in jobs.json runs. Local engines are reached over an SSH forward on Aaron's private Tailscale network; nothing is opened to the internet and no key is stored here. local-big = Blink, the 8B model on its graphics chip (measured 2026-11-15: a daily brief in about 10 seconds). local-small = GMKtec K15, the 4B model on its processor (20 to 45 seconds); the 8B is too slow there (95 to 245 seconds). The two local engines back each other up: if one PC is down or its answer fails the checks, the other runs the job, and only then does it go to claude. claude = a job a Claude session runs by hand; the runner never calls it.
